builds.sourceNote: Candidate source frozen before final timing; no source edits, builds, tests or encoders during these windows.

scope: Default retains distant-only clustering; nearby:true is optional. Blended/refractive materials retain separate sorting.
Only changed clusters synchronize source attributes. The settled-wind CPU regression test observes zero retained source-version reads over 30 frames.
World: baseline/default/default/baseline, fully loaded and warmed resident views, 12 seconds each, matching residents and selected terrain triangles. FPS counts submissions and can queue GPU work.

Tropical: external 7,323-plant project, Standard water, coast/canopy forward/reverse, 90 warmup frames and 10-second windows, one unfinished GPU frame. All source artwork remains outside the repository.

No source edits, builds, tests or encoders during these accepted timings. Earlier near-field prototypes while source was being edited are excluded from performance claims. Background system/clock variability remains.
World FPS ranges overlap and one candidate open-view run slows down; no reliable default-path FPS gain is established.

Near-field tropical comparison is one library run per configuration, with forward/reverse views, and supports lower batch/submission cost in these views rather than a universal speedup. Foliage counts are selected before frustum culling; authored population is unchanged.
Tropical forward/reverse coast select different plant counts due to LOD history; compare modes within the matching phase only.
Tracked renderer bytes omit driver allocations and CPU source buffers. Wider clusters retain extra source streams and reduce culling precision.
All tested fixed world views pass p95 <=33.5 ms in this quiet run. Whole-world streaming stalls and long-session/dense-scene acceptance remain separate and unproven.

browser.note: 11 passed after dirty-cluster implementation; final five-case run rechecks the opt-in/default wiring, near-field cross-fade pixels, density, motion and world release. Initial full unit run caught a source-storage fixture counting the new cluster mesh; it now explicitly selects source batches and retains all sharing/isolation assertions. Full suite passes.
